sentences.text: The type species Planocrania datangensis was named in 1976 from fossils found in Nanxiong, Guangdong Province, China.
A second species, Planocrania hengdongensis, was described in 1984 from fossils found in Hengdong County, Hunan Province.
A 2013 analysis suggested Planocrania is closely related to Boverisuchus, leading to the reinstatement of the family Planocraniidae.
Planocrania lived between 60.9 and 56 million years ago during the Selandian to Thanetian stages.
A 2018 study using molecular and morphological data recovered Planocraniidae outside the crown group Crocodylia.
